name: Extract multi-tcks from wmc + wbfg or composite tck
summary: Splits a whole-brain or composite tractogram into one .tck file per tract using the tract assignments in a white matter classification (wmc), with MRtrix3 connectome2tck.
description: Converts the wmc classification into a streamline index list (DIPY container), then runs MRtrix3 connectome2tck to write each classified tract as its own .tck file named after the tract. Use it to obtain per-tract tractograms for visualisation or tract-wise analysis. The tck input must be the tractogram the classification was computed on, so that streamline indices match.

inputs.description: Whole-brain (or composite) tractogram the classification indexes into.
inputs.requirements: Must be the tractogram used to generate the wmc classification.

inputs.description: White matter classification (wmc) assigning streamlines to named tracts.

outputs.description: Directory with one .tck tractogram per classified tract.

failure_modes.message: something went wrong. check derivatives and logs
failure_modes.cause: No .tck files were written to tcks/.
failure_modes.fix: Make sure the wmc classification was computed on the provided tractogram.
